messages:
mike: heads-up, seeing a sudden cluster bump of NVIDIA Xid 31 and sporadic Xid 13 on the us-west2 A10 pool since ~02:17 UTC. embedder 99p latency climbed ~1.9x. attaching kernel excerpts below.

rachel: is this concentrated to a rack or spread across the pool? any tenant affinity?

mike: mostly rack-usw2-14 (nodes 02/05/08). heavy on tenant 'search-embed' and one internal evaluation job. fabric looks clean. kernel snippet:```
[2026-07-12T02:17:23Z] nvidia 0000:af:00.0: Xid (31) CE error, ch 00000004, pid 11234
[2026-07-12T02:17:23Z] nvidia 0000:af:00.0: GPU reset
[2026-07-12T02:17:24Z] ce_count=23 ecc_uncorr=0 temp=69
```

devin: hunch: long decode sequences + dense KV cache churn hitting decoder kernel path on A10 firmware. can you reproduce on a spare node with tenant-shaped load? try:```
python infra/tests/run_workload.py --model redwood/embedder-xl --batch 20 --seq 3072 --concurrency 3 --duration 600
```

claudia: triage proposal: 1) soft-drain top 2 noisy nodes in rack-usw2-14, 2) collect NVML/PMU traces + run vendor memtest overnight, 3) reproduce with KV cache disabled to isolate decoder vs cache pressure. if memtest fails -> RMA.

sre-bot: INCIDENT INF-9001 opened: repeated GPU resets (Xid 31/13) in rack-usw2-14. Notifying eng-runtime + eng-infra. :rotating_light:

rachel: immediate mitigation: lower search-embed max_batch_timeout from 150ms -> 45ms and cap concurrent requests to 4. I'll canary to 8% traffic now. also enable extra logging for long-seq requests. :gear:

mike: running reproduce on spare node-14-10, collecting smi every 2s and nvml traces. initial reproduce produced 3 Xid31 within first 90s. uploading traces to INF-9001.

devin: if reproduction only triggers with seq >= 2048 and batch >= 16, that's strong signal for decoder kernel stress. try a smaller seq (1024) and toggling quantization path to see delta. also check that driver/firmware versions match fleet baseline.

claudia: noted. firmware is a10-fw-2026-02 across fleet; driver 540.xx. if hw passes memtest and we can repro, plan is file kernel/oom report and escalate to NV support (cc nv-support-bot).

nv-support-bot: Acknowledged. Please include full dmesg, nvml samples, and reproduce trace. Escalation ticket created with NVIDIA case ref NV-23314.

mike: thanks all. soft-drain queued for nodes 02/05, diag running, and mitigation canary in flight. will update INF-9001 with results. :thumbsup:
